title: contentDisposition filename* contains characters that are not attr-char
prompt: When contentDisposition(filename) has to use the extended filename*=UTF-8''... parameter (non-ASCII file names), the percent-encoded value can still contain characters that are not allowed in an RFC 5987 attr-char, for example '(' ')' ',' ';' '=' '@' or brackets, and so produces an invalid header. The value should be encoded so that only valid attr-chars remain unescaped. Please fix it.
